title: Define candidate matrix and repeat/comparison contract
goal: Assess existing compare/repeat/report behavior and define compatible comparison dimensions
acceptance: Specify bounded candidate identity/configuration matrix, compatible dimensions and repetition policy
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures only. No real model calls, downloads, secrets, private transcripts or consumer implementation.
validation: Meaningful protocol/pack/grader or compare/report join fixtures
Typecheck, deterministic tests, build, generated capability index and final required CI; actual model qualification is separately scoped
escalation: Material scope/effort expansion or distinct outcome split requires owner agreement
No real-model campaign, installation or consumer-dependent release gate

effort.basis: Initial contract assessment; source identity and incompatible configuration behavior may expose additional work.
